description: Outcome of one Orbit CLI command run or MCP tool call.

command.description: Name of the CLI command that ran, such as `query` or `graph_status`.

tool_name.description: Name of the MCP tool called, such as `run_sql`. Null when the event is not an MCP tool call.

success.description: True when the command finished without an error.

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the command.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the command, in milliseconds.

cli_version.description: Version of the Orbit CLI binary, such as `0.42.0`.
